dependencies.name: git
dependencies.purpose: Clones the pinned rhize-tasks runtime tag into the local source checkout so the installer can run from source.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Setup cannot bootstrap the runtime source checkout, and doctor cannot report source drift.

replacement.suggestion: Install Xcode Command Line Tools (includes git) or Git for Mac.
replacement.warning: There is no supported replacement for git in the bootstrap step.

dependencies.name: node
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Rhize Tasks cannot run the cloned runtime's installer, CLI, or local planning service.

replacement.suggestion: Install a supported Node.js 22 or newer runtime.
replacement.warning: Older Node versions do not provide the supported runtime floor for this plugin.

dependencies.name: macOS 14+
dependencies.purpose: Provides Keychain and EventKit support for local credentials and Apple Reminders.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Rhize Tasks cannot provide its supported local Keychain and Apple Reminders integration.

replacement.suggestion: Use a Mac running macOS 14 or newer.
replacement.warning: The plugin has no supported replacement for the macOS Keychain and EventKit integration.

dependencies.name: rhize-tasks runtime
dependencies.purpose: The local-first planning service, installer, and Swift EventKit helper this plugin's skills drive. The plugin ships no runtime code itself.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Setup cannot bootstrap the runtime; clone Rhize-Media/rhize-tasks at the pinned tag and run installer/install.mjs by hand.

wizard.purpose: Install the local Rhize Tasks planning service, its signed Swift EventKit helper, and both LaunchAgents.

artifacts.purpose: Rhize Tasks' SQLite state, versioned runtime, install manifest, routine lock, logs, and the Swift helper bundle. Secrets live in Keychain, not here.
LaunchAgent invoking the routine catch-up evaluator every 15 minutes and at load.
LaunchAgent serving the signed Swift EventKit helper's Unix socket, owning the macOS Reminders permission grant.
The pinned-tag clone of the rhize-tasks runtime repo the setup wizard bootstraps and the installer runs from. Not the installed runtime itself (that lives under runtime/, owned by the installer).
